resources.string: Accessibility service for simulated tap gestures based on user configuration.
Tap the floating icon to control or open the application.
Please grant the following permissions to enable automated tap features smoothly.
Required to dispatch tap gestures on your behalf without requiring root access.
Required to display the floating control bar and target pointer on top of other screens.
Required on Android 13+ to maintain Foreground Service stability without being killed.
Prevents aggressive OEM battery managers from abruptly terminating the background service.
This application uses the AccessibilityService API solely for user-instructed automation gestures. Users are responsible for complying with third-party application terms of service.
